reviews.review_title: Order delivered....but stolen!!  No way to contact anyone by phone or through live chat...only tickets!!
reviews.review_text:
I placed an order with Shein on June 12 & the order was delivered on my front porch in plain view on June 23,2026!  When I got home from work the package was not there....I inquired with my neighbors & the majority were at work & those who were home didn't see anything  so obviously my package was stolen!!! They could've left my package in my rock garden right next to the door behind the plants or thrown over the side fence right next to the rock garden.....but no they left it on the porch in front of the door where it was visible for everyone walking on the sidewalk to see!! I tried every way to contact them...they have no line to call & there's no way you can send an email to actually explain your situation!! They have tickets that you choose from which you click on so I clicked on package was delivered but not recieved!  They sent me a ticket stating "refund request accepted" & then they sent me a ticket stating "refund failed" because the package was delivered & that I would have to contact the courrier company "UNI" (1st time I hear of this company they never delivered to me before) & to send proof that the package was stolen!! First of all its not my responsibility to contact UNI Shein hired them & they work for Shein!!  Second...I don't have cameras in front of my house & if I had seen it being stolen....it wouldn't have been stolen  cause I would've been there to intercept!!  I've ordered many times from Shein & never had a problem....but it was always delivered  by Canada Post!! And the worst part is that if there was someone to talk to I could've told them that I didn't want my money back...I just wanted all the items I ordered to be redelivered for the $149.50 I paid!!  Shein customer service is pathetically horrible....the absolute worse!! You definitely should consider hiring live people to resolve certain issues like mine & many others...so that we don't have to deal with tickets as an option!  Also give the option of where a package should  be deli ered where customers can actually write ex: in the rock garden...over side fence etc...
Its sad really...I ordered alot of stuff from them & was quite pleased, not always but 
most of the time & I've also referred many people to them!! This is the 1st time I encountered a problem & their way of dealing with customers you would think they'd want to keep is judgemental & horrible!! You only screw me over once...if you're going to treat me like a ticket then I will take the necessary measures to get back what belongs to me...I have no order...you don't get to keep my money....it's about principal...how you under value your customers & make them feel like they did something wrong!! Remember they're quick to take your money but if a problem occurs there is absolutely no way to get in touch with them....so buyers  beware only order from reputable companies where they have an excellent customer service in place with live interactions or a telephone line you can call!!

reviews.review_text: Since Shein started using UNIUNI for delivery instead of Canada post, receiving orders has been a nightmare. My experience on June 22, 2026 was not palatable. My order no was GSH17706Q0002HN and contained 24 items. I never received the package. In my experience with previous deliveries,  SMS notifications for delivery is sent, the drivers usually knock, request a signature, or hand the package directly to me. None of these occurred in this case. I got just an sms with a photo the package was delivered. The package was not present when I checked around the timeframe. Neighbours did not see any package at my door around the delivery timeframe. I raised up the issue immediately with UNIUNI and escalated to SHEIN. The details of the driver was shielded and my application for refund was rejected.

reviews.review_title: Refund Policy Is Meaningless
reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with SHEIN.

The clothes didn’t fit me, and the press-on nails were too long to use. My refund is only about $35, but the return shipping from Azerbaijan to Dubai costs almost the same amount. This makes the return practically impossible.

I contacted customer support several times, explained my situation, and even asked them to consider an exception. My request was escalated, but I only received the same standard response over and over again.

This experience has completely changed my opinion of SHEIN. I will never order from SHEIN again. From now on, I will choose Temu instead, where I have never had any problems with returns, and where both the prices and customer service are much better.

I am truly disappointed
